coordination.readiness: A pending task is eligible only when dependencies are done, its phase is authorized and required decisions are resolved.

tasks.title: Inspect target repository and reconcile requirements
acceptance: Classify actual local implementation; preserve existing work
Map every source requirement to implemented, missing, deferred or excluded status

tasks.title: Freeze boundaries and phase contracts
acceptance: Record technical defaults and unresolved business-source decisions
Freeze role matrix, lifecycles, authority and contract version for P1

tasks.title: Create pinned local runtime and check commands
acceptance: Compatible exact versions and lockfiles recorded
Web, API and Postgres start locally; health checks pass
Record actual lint/typecheck/test/build commands in docs/development/CHECKS.md

tasks.title: Implement identity, branch scope and catalog API
acceptance: Migrations apply on empty Postgres
Session/CSRF and direct unauthorized object requests tested
Variant units and published/private catalog fields tested

tasks.title: Create typed client and accessible catalog shell
acceptance: Client conforms to exported schema
Catalog list/detail and session states use actual local API
No private server response cached across users

tasks.title: Verify foundation vertical slice
acceptance: Customer and employee catalog journeys pass
No credential/real store fixtures
Reviewer findings resolved before phase completion

tasks.title: Implement staged catalog import and provenance
acceptance: Import rerun idempotent
Distinct variants preserved; rejected rows reported
Imports cannot publish live stock or authoritative prices

tasks.title: Implement exact/fuzzy/synonym/attribute search
acceptance: Exact SKU priority and Spanish synonyms verified
Hard attribute constraints enforced
Golden synthetic candidate cases meet recorded recall target

tasks.title: Integrate search cards and import report views
acceptance: Search/filter/reset and empty/error states pass
Real catalog references or visibly synthetic fixtures only
Import reports restricted to authorized staff

tasks.title: Verify search and ingestion isolation
acceptance: Import injection/invalid-data scenarios covered
Search relevance results recorded
Rights/source uncertainty remains visible

tasks.title: Implement inventory authority and locking
acceptance: UNKNOWN distinct from verified zero
Stock/source age and branch tests pass
Concurrent Postgres allocation and adjustment invariants hold
Authorized release/expiry still succeeds when source freshness is unavailable

tasks.title: Implement prices and immutable quotations
acceptance: Decimal rounding and unit boundary cases tested
Issued snapshots immutable; version/expiry checks tested
Quotes never reserve stock

tasks.title: Implement reserved orders and fulfillment
acceptance: Conversion all-or-nothing and one order per accepted quote version
Expiry/picking/cancel races tested on Postgres
Repeated fulfillment cannot double-decrement stock
Concurrent same-key/different-payload requests conflict without duplicate effects

tasks.title: Implement quote, sales and warehouse journeys
acceptance: Quote acceptance and order state UX follows actual APIs
Conflict/UNKNOWN and retry semantics handled
No payment concepts or controls introduced

tasks.title: Verify operational lifecycle and access controls
acceptance: Quote-to-fulfillment E2E passes
Evidence includes real Postgres concurrency outcomes
Security reviewer resolves cross-scope/idempotency findings

tasks.title: Implement AI adapter, scoped reads and evidence validation
acceptance: Typed tools call domain services as caller
Unknown/unauthorized/stale evidence rejected
General prose cannot introduce unsupported store facts

tasks.title: Implement clarifications, policies and confirmed quote proposal
acceptance: All canonical scenarios represented
Explicit application confirmation required for draft quote
No reservation/order/price mutation tool

tasks.title: Implement grounded assistant interface
acceptance: Hydrated cards and actual catalog candidate images
Freshness and failed-tool states understandable
No unvalidated recommendation streamed to user

tasks.title: Run offline and authorized provider evaluations
acceptance: Offline and provider results labeled separately
Zero fabricated store claims and critical unsafe advice in release set
Record model/version/cost/latency and human review; provider budget authorization required

tasks.title: Complete scoped management APIs and service hardening
acceptance: Staff-management and audit endpoints enforce role/branch scope
Rate limits, retention and redacted diagnostics tested
Customer-facing schemas exclude internal costs and staff fields

tasks.title: Complete management, accessibility and observability
acceptance: Scoped staff/audit views use actual API
Keyboard/mobile loading/error states verified
Management views consume implemented scoped APIs

tasks.title: Rehearse backup restore and prepare runbooks
acceptance: Local backup restored and domain balances reconciled
Recovery procedure and redacted diagnostics verified
No production deployment or paid resources created

tasks.title: Independent release readiness review
acceptance: All phase gates have executed evidence
Security review has no unresolved release blockers
Real-data, business settings and hosting unknowns are explicit blockers

tasks.title: Scope optional expansions individually
acceptance: Owner selects individual extensions
New state/contracts and tests proposed before code
Payments remain excluded
